Klasse StrategyDeciderFINALSUBMISSION

java.lang.Object
strategyDeciders.AbstractStrategyDecider
strategyDeciders.StrategyDeciderFINALSUBMISSION
public class StrategyDeciderFINALSUBMISSION extends AbstractStrategyDecider
This StrategyDecider is a concrete implementation of AbstractStrategyDecider. It defines the final decision logic and strategic calculations used by the agent.

This StrategyDecider is the strategy on which the agent decides its moves. It combines aggressively attacking the visible enemy nodes with expansion by occupying neutral nodes, fallback mechanism and hiding the strongest node form the enemy.

This StrategyDecider adapts its behavior mainly based on the current ring size.

  • the current ring size,
  • the visibility (own strategy for visibility with range <= 2,
  • the enemy's behavior in terms of expansion and defense.
It also checks if the strongest node has reached the maximum capacity per node and.

  • Methodendetails

    • decide

      public String decide()
      Decides and composes the move for each step.

      Decisions are mainly based on the ring size of the current game, the visibility and the enemy's behavior. The method combines multiple moves from different move categories in one single move String.

      Angegeben von:
      decide in Klasse AbstractStrategyDecider
      Gibt zurück:
      a valid move String representing the combination of all executed moves in the current step. If no move was executed, an empty String will be returned.
